summary: Noah Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of 5,000 restricted share units (RSUs) covering 50,000 shares (10,000 ADSs) to one employee participant under the 2022 Share Incentive Plan. The RSUs were granted on June 29, 2026 at no purchase price; the closing ADS price was $10.06. Vesting occurs in four equal annual installments subject to continued employment and performance targets. This is a routine equity compensation grant, not a special situation.
